_README: Config for scripts/deploy.sh. No secrets here — the deployer keypair is read from ANCHOR_WALLET (never this repo). `defaultCluster` is the target when SOLANA_CLUSTER is unset (testnet-first). `clusters` maps a cluster name to its RPC URL (override per cluster with SOLANA_RPC_URL). `relayKey` maps the Solana cluster to the key the relay expects under config.json -> htlc.solana. `fee` seeds the one-time initialize(fee_bps, fee_wallet) AFTER deploy; feeWallet must be set by the operator (a PUBLIC address).
